title: Presidents Cup
metaDescription: Presidents Cup: verified dates, location and OneSliders event context for Golf.

overview.about: The Presidents Cup is a biennial team match-play event between the United States and an International team drawn from the rest of the world outside Europe. Modelled on the Ryder Cup but without prize money, it has been dominated by the US side, who have won all but one edition.
overview.nextEvent: The next Presidents Cup is a three-day team contest of foursomes, fourballs and singles between the USA and the International team, this edition at Medinah Country Club near Chicago. Players compete for their team and continent, with no prize money.
